pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Āḷaviyaṃ viharati Aggāḷave cetiye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.2: tena kho pana samayena upāsakā ārāmaṃ āgacchanti dhammasavanāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.3: dhamme bhāsite therā bhikkhū yathāvihāraṃ gacchanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.4: navakā bhikkhū tatth' eva upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ upāsakehi saddhiṃ muṭṭhassatī asampajānā naggā vikūjamānā kākacchamānā seyyaṃ kappenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā muṭṭhassatī asampajānā naggā vikūjamānā kākacchamānā seyyaṃ kappessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ upāsakānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.8: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū anupasampannena sahaseyyaṃ kappessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.10: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ --la--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū anupasampannena sahaseyyaṃ kappentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.14: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā anupasampannena sahaseyyaṃ kappessanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.15: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.16: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.17.1: yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.18: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.1: atha kho bhagavā Ālaviyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Kosambī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Kosambī tad avasari. tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Badarikārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.4: bhagavatā āvuso Rāhula sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ: na anupasampannena sahaseyyā kappetabbā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.6: atha kho āyasmā Rāhulo seyyaṃ alabhamāno vaccakuṭiyā seyyaṃ kappesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.7: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena vaccakuṭī ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā ukkāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.12: atha kho āyasmā Rāhulo bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave anupasampannena dvirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappetuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.15: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.16.1: yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena uttaridvirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.1.12: sabbacchannā sabbaparicchannā yebhuyyena cchannā yebhuyyena paricchannā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.1.14: catutthe divase atthaṃgate suriye anupasampanne nipanne bhikkhu nipajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.1.15: bhikkhu nipanne anupasampanno nipajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.2.1: anupasampanne anupasampannasaññī uttaridvirattatirattaṃ sahaseyyaṃ kappeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.2.2: anupasampanne vematiko utt. s. k., āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.2.3: anupasampanne upasampannasaññī utt. s. k., āpatti pācittiyassa.
